## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope and safety

- [ ] This change is limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] No credentials, live client data, identity documents, bank details, private contacts, or current commercial terms are included.
- [ ] Consequential workflow actions remain subject to human approval.
- [ ] Architecture or workflow decisions are documented where applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm audit`
- [ ] Relevant automated tests
- [ ] Relevant browser or integration verification

## Evidence

List screenshots, audit records, test output, or manual scenarios used to verify the change.

## Rollback

Explain how this change can be safely reverted or disabled.
